en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, raising it, said,
‘Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When you slaughter the sheep, and strip it, or strip off something from it before it dies, it is not Permissible to eat it’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from in a marfu‘ manner the following: “
Abu al-Hassan, al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘When you slaughter a sheep and remove its skin or a certain part of its skin before it dies, it then is not lawful to use it for food.’”
